newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 300 mln bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 300 mln bfr.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury's linear bond exchange auction totalled 300 million francs, the Treasury said in a statement BELE.
At the auction, participants could exchange OLOs expiring in January 1997 and August 1997 for those expiring in July 1998, December 2000, June 2002 and October 2004.
The only offers made were to exchange the January 1997 OLO for the June 2002.
